hazards.name: Hazards: The Bestiary
hazards.description: Every creature in the Ada world, assembled in one place. 69 entities across 16 themed sections. The original collection — origami folders, sphere rollers, wall-crawlers, grid agents, procedural legs, companions — now joined by 30 sequence-specific creatures. Each new creature embodies the algorithm of its home sequence through geometry and behavior: a binary search tree that walks on its leaves, a gradient descent predator stuck in local minima, an Escher figure on impossible stairs. Mathematics given teeth.
hazards.qfep_connection: Hazards embody the tension between entropy and form. Each creature is a topology — a body that folds, rolls, extends, or shapeshifts. The personality progression from foe to friend mirrors the Q-FEP insight: same potential, different relational context, different manifestation. The force field that burns also warms. The plasma that shocks also heals. Constraint determines outcome.
learning_objectives: Origami mathematics made physical — Miura-ori, Kresling, waterbomb, kaleidocycle folds
Procedural creature generation — IK chains, limb variants, morphology
Procedural locomotion progression — from 1 leg to 8, watching gaits emerge
Grid agent modes — copy, random, CA, sine, array, color, rotate, scale, translate
Dual-nature design — every hazard contains its own medicine
Personality progression — foe, wary, neutral, curious, friend
HazardManager integration — type gating, spawn permission, befriending
Algorithm embodiment — data structures, physics simulation, growth patterns as creatures
Spatial field hazards — noise, Voronoi, isosurfaces, constraint satisfaction as zones
AI and stochastic systems — gradient descent, Markov chains, procedural generation as behavior
content: Origami Folders: Miura crawler, Kresling spire, Kaleidocycle, Scissor stalker, Pyre plane — creatures built from folding mathematics
Sphere Rollers: Armadillo droideka, Eggling, Origami droideka, Waterbomb enemy, Sphere droideka — roll compressed, unfold to attack
Crawlers & Energy: Octapod crawler, Waterbomb hopper, Plasma critter, Force field — surface traversal and dual-nature forms
Grid Agents: 9 modes — Copy, Random, CA, Sine, Array, Color, Rotate, Scale, Translate
Procedural Legs: 1 through 8 legs — locomotion emerging from leg count
Special Creatures: Block Builder, Tech Strider, Tentacle Cube, Falling Blocks
Items & Companions: Edible mushroom, Stick tool, Proximity spawner, The Catalyst, Loving Triangle
Math & Data Structures: Index Sentinel (arrays), Data Tree Walker (BST), Graph Weaver (graph theory), Hull Crusher (convex geometry)
Physics & Simulation: Wave Rider (wave functions), Spring Mass Bouncer (soft bodies), Collision Crasher (impulse physics), Joint Articulator (constraints)
Nature & Growth: Lifeform Walker (cellular automata), Branching Vine (L-systems), Fractal Hydra (self-similarity), Recursion Spiral (Fibonacci), Swarm Hive (flocking)
AI & Stochastic: Gradient Hunter (ML descent), Grammar Markov (transition chains), Maze Spinner (PCG), Paradox Stalker (foundations crisis)
Spatial Fields: Noise Field (Perlin), Chromatic Field (RGB), Spatial Voronoi (partitions), Isosurface Trap (metaballs), Constraint Web (CSP)
Patterns & Sound: Pattern Mine (SDF contours), Resonance Chamber (standing waves), Particle Emitter (lifecycle pools)
Higher Math & Art: Tesseract Phaser (4D), Escher Stairwalker (impossible geometry), Mesh Morpher (topology), Bricoleur Golem (improvisation), QFEP Calibrator (parameter space)
